caption: The drawing depicts a highly decorative architectural wall and alcove, featuring classical elements and vibrant colors. At the right side, a niche with two cream-colored and gold-trimmed columns contains a standing statue of a person in a brown robe on a small pink pedestal. Surrounding the niche are ornate motifs, such as stylized foliage in green and gold, blue paneling, and yellow and orange scrolls. Above, a semicircular arch with geometric patterns in blue, yellow, and green is flanked by decorative elements including a cornice in blue and gold. In the top center, a painted frieze includes a blue cloud with a red and gold object surrounded by two winged cherubs (one on each side) on a blue background. To the left, a single standalone column in yellow, blue, and gold is shown. In the lower left, a rectangular inset highlights details of two painted motifs: one a black, pink, and green floral form, the other a stylized flower in pink and blue, each set against a white background. The lower section contains a decorative corner structure with curved trim in blue, pink, and light brown, and wall panels with green, orange, and red geometric and animal motifs. The floor is composed of terracotta tiles in shades of orange and brown. The drawing uses a palette of blue, yellow, pink, green, white, black, orange, and gold, and is annotated “Scale 1/2” = 1’” and "Scale 1” = 1’” in red text at the bottom left.
title: Side Altar, San Luis Rey Mission
